verdict.rationale: Docs confirm LangChain/LangGraph agents can consume MCP server tools via an MCPAdapter that discovers and adapts them into LangChain tools, satisfying the core ask, but this is a single thin doc reference with no setup detail, config examples, or independent/community corroboration. Missing for 10: detailed first-party guide on configuring MCP servers, code examples, and independent/hands-on validation that MCP tool-calling works reliably in LangGraph graphs.
